page_title: WHU 0-1 NEW | West Ham v Newcastle 10/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Michael Salisbury is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The linesman signals a throw-in for Newcastle.
90+4' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
90+3' A cross into the box from Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is cleared.
90+3' The percentage of ball possession is – 50:50.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' West Ham fail to score from a corner as Nick Pope (Newcastle Utd) leaps to collect the ball.
90' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. West Ham get a corner.

90' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Michael Salisbury with no other option than to blow for a foul. West Ham have a free kick.
88' Eddie Howe has decided to make a change. Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) replaces Bruno Guimaraes.
87' Carlos Soler (West Ham) was too forceful with his tackle and Michael Salisbury interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
85' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
84' Here comes a substitution. James Ward-Prowse is given a rest as he is replaced by Danny Ings (West Ham).
84' Michael Salisbury shows a yellow card to Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) for his blatant foul.
82' Newcastle have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
82' A cross from Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball goes out of play and Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick.
81' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
81' The game is interrupted. Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
80' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
79' Eddie Howe prepares a substitution. Harvey Barnes is replaced by Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd).
79' We are about to witness a subsitution. Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) for Alexander Isak.
78' Michael Salisbury couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) and blew his whistle.
78' It's a throw-in for West Ham.

76' Oliver Scarles (West Ham) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
73' Nick Pope (Newcastle Utd) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
72' Nick Pope (Newcastle Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
72' Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) sends a long ball forward to Jarrod Bowen, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. It's a throw-in for Newcastle.
70' One of the West Ham players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
70' Nick Pope (Newcastle Utd) plays a terrific long ball forward to Dan Burn, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
69' A substitution has been made. Aaron Cresswell is replaced by Evan Ferguson (West Ham).
68' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
65' Here is a change. Tomas Soucek is going off and Graham Potter gives the last tactical orders to Lucas Paqueta (West Ham).
65' Graham Potter has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) replacing Jean-Clair Todibo.
65' The manager makes a subsitution with Carlos Soler (West Ham) coming on for Edson Alvarez.

63' 0 - 1 What an excellent finish! Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) latched on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and rifled an unstoppable low drive into the middle of the net and past the helpless goalkeeper.
62' Close! Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) is a whisker away from finishing-off the move he started. His close-range effort flies just over the bar.
60' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Alphonse Areola has no trouble gathering it.
59' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Newcastle.
56' Michael Salisbury blows for a foul after Tomas Soucek (West Ham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
55' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
54' The ball goes out for a corner. West Ham can continue in their attacking effort.

54' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. West Ham have been awarded a corner kick.
53' The corner is swung in but West Ham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
53' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. West Ham win a corner.
51' A nice individual effort by Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
49' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from West Ham for a penalty. Play continues.
49' Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
48' An attempted cross from Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) is cleared.
47' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Michael Salisbury has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Michael Salisbury interrupts the game. One of the players from West Ham won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' The ball is behind the touchline and Newcastle will take a throw-in.
44' Jean-Clair Todibo (West Ham) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
44' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
42' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
40' The ball is cleared after Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
37' Wasted opportunity! Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
35' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
34' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
34' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
33' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
32' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
31' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) passes the ball onto Harvey Barnes, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
30' Nick Pope blocks a long-range effort from Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) towards the middle of the goal.
29' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
28' The ball is out of play. West Ham will take a throw-in.
27' The referee blows his whistle as Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) was too aggressive in his challenge.
26' A pass from Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) is intercepted by Alphonse Areola and the move breaks down.
25' The resulting set piece from Newcastle is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

25' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him. The ball is out of play and Newcastle manage to earn a corner.
24' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.

24' Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Newcastle.
24' A pass finds the feet of Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
23' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
23' The ball is out of play. West Ham will have a throw-in.

20' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Alphonse Areola pulls off a comfortable save.
19' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Newcastle.
18' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post.
15' Newcastle are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
13' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
12' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends a long ball in, but Alphonse Areola comfortably gathers the ball.

11' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession. The ball has crossed the sideline. Newcastle are taking a throw-in.
10' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
9' Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
9' The linesman signals a throw-in for Newcastle.
7' Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
5' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
5' Michael Salisbury blows the whistle, Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) is penalised for a foul.
2' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. West Ham will have the kick-off.
Michael Salisbury will officiate today.
